checks.name: Actual eight records and four complete source-edition pairs pass the reader contract
Every actual PNG passes byte count, SHA and PNG signature independently
Corruption, truncated bytes and a wrong PNG signature are refused before decode
Remote, absolute, traversal, encoded and fragment source paths are refused
Edition promotion, procedural mirroring and fake animation claims fail closed
Documentary moth and contextual alligator cannot acquire a combat state
Duplicate sides, unknown states and mismatched family labels are refused
The reader has no game-state, storage, timing or image-mirror writes

scope: Independent validation of actual PNG bytes, declared pair contracts and rejected corruption/paths/edition promotion. This does not certify original game pixels or animation.
